snippet.title: Sonzai - Official Playtest Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take another look at Sonzai in this latest trailer for the upcoming story-rich, social link based RPG with combo character action and JRPG elements. The town of Kumotoshi holds secrets. A new life, new people, new spirits. What are the threads that bind people together? What is the nature of magic? All presented in a beautiful, completely hand-drawn style. Sonzai will be available on PC. Playtest sign-ups are now open.
